info.title: Crypto Idea API
info.description:
HTTP surface of the CryptoIdea backend (Firebase Cloud Functions + Firestore rules).

1. **Public REST** (`/api/*`) — no auth; cached market data, public config, landing email capture.

2. **Callables** — Firebase `onCall`: POST `{"data": …}`, get `{"result": …}` or `{"error": {message, status, details}}`. Each verifies the ID token and acts on `context.auth.uid` only. Admin callables also need the `{admin:true}` claim with role `manager` or `owner`.

3. **PayPal webhook** (`/paypalWebhook`) — authenticated by PayPal's webhook signature.

Secrets stay server-side and are never returned to a client.

servers.description: Production Cloud Functions base (replace YOUR_PROJECT). REST is also served at https://<your-domain>/api/*.

tags.name: MarketData
tags.description: Public, cached CoinGecko market data (prices, search, coin list, history, trending).

tags.name: Config
tags.description: Public non-secret app configuration read by the client on load.

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Signed-in user self-service account actions (GDPR/CCPA, sessions, counters).

tags.name: Research
tags.description: Signed-in user AI research proxy — asks about the caller's OWN holdings; fail-closed, server-side output validation, app-wide budget-metered.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Admin-only. Requires the {admin:true} claim with role `manager` (read + account management) or `owner` (Settings, manager grants, erasure). Owners can never be deleted, trashed or demoted, and managers cannot act on owners.

get.summary: Current price + market data for one or more coins
get.description: Served from the shared cached coin universe; long-tail coins are refreshed on demand and folded back so upstream cost stays flat regardless of user count. Public and CDN-cached (max-age 120s).

parameters.name: ids
parameters.description: Comma-separated CoinGecko coin ids (e.g. `bitcoin,ethereum`). Capped at 500; blank ids are dropped.

200.description: Map of coin id → price entry (only requested ids that resolved are present).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

get.summary: Search the coin universe by id / name / symbol
get.description: Client-side-friendly search over the cached ~3,000-coin universe (no per-search upstream call). Returns up to 25 matches sorted by market-cap rank. Public, CDN-cached (max-age 300s).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term (lower-cased, capped at 100 chars). Empty returns an empty list.

429.description: Rate limited / resource exhausted — retry later.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

get.summary: Full coin list (metadata + last price) for the landing DCA calculator
get.description: The whole cached coin universe (id/symbol/name/icon/rank + price + 24h change). Public, CDN-cached for a day.

429.description: Rate limited / resource exhausted — retry later.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

get.description: CoinGecko /search/trending, cached in its own doc (30-min TTL) and on the CDN. Backs the Search tab empty state. Public; an empty array signals the client to use its built-in fallback list.

429.description: Rate limited / resource exhausted — retry later.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

get.description: Non-secret app config: maintenance, signups, plans, feature flags, analytics and legal IDs. Never includes secrets. Public, CDN-cached 60s.

429.description: Rate limited / resource exhausted — retry later.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

get.summary: Daily price history for one coin
get.description: Daily price series fetched once per coin and reused for every date range and every user (cached 30 days). Public, CDN-cached (max-age 86400s).

200.description: Array of `[timestampMs, price]` pairs (empty if unavailable — the client degrades to its built-in estimate).

429.description: Rate limited / resource exhausted — retry later.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Landing-page email capture (public write)
post.description: Public landing email capture; emails the address to the site owner over SMTP. Rate-limited to 5/min per IP, with a honeypot field.

200.description: Accepted (also returned for a tripped honeypot, which is silently dropped).

502.description: Upstream email provider rejected the request.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Start a PayPal subscription checkout for the signed-in user
post.description: Callable. Creates a PayPal subscription for the caller (tier × billing cycle chosen server-side) and returns the approval URL. Refused when paid plans or checkout are off, for the current tier, or within a 60s cooldown.

200.description: Approval URL to redirect the user to.

401.description: Not signed in.

500.description: internal / failed-precondition (already on this plan, plan not configured).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Schedule a future-start Pro downgrade for a Premium user
post.description: Callable. Premium user only. Creates a future-start PayPal Pro subscription that first charges when Premium ends; returns the approval URL. Refused when paid plans are off, if already scheduled, or within a 60s cooldown.

200.description: Approval URL to redirect the user to (null in the DEV/emulator branch).

400.description: invalid-argument (unknown field) / failed-precondition (paused, checkout unavailable, not premium, already scheduled, plan not configured).

401.description: Not signed in.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Future-start Premium re-subscribe for a cancelled-Premium user
post.description: Callable. Cancelled-Premium user only. Creates a future-start PayPal Premium subscription that continues at period end; returns the approval URL. Refused when paid plans are off, a downgrade is pending, or within a 60s cooldown.

200.description: Approval URL to redirect the user to (null in the DEV/emulator branch).

400.description: invalid-argument (unknown field) / failed-precondition (paused, checkout unavailable, not a cancelled premium, a scheduled downgrade is still pending, plan not configured).

401.description: Not signed in.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: AI research — ask about your own holdings
post.description: Callable. Answers a question (≤500 chars) about the caller's own portfolio. Output is validated server-side and never contains advice, price targets or allocations. Needs aiResearch on; per-user daily and app-wide monthly budgets. Returns { answer, fellBack }.

200.description: The answer (empty string on a fail-closed fallback) and whether it fell back.

400.description: invalid-argument (blank/non-string/too-long question, or an unknown field) / failed-precondition (aiResearch kill-switch off, or no AI provider key/models configured).

401.description: Not signed in.

429.description: resource-exhausted — the per-uid daily budget is exhausted, or the app-wide monthly $-cap has been reached.

503.description: unavailable — the monthly AI budget ledger could not be read (fail-closed refusal).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Add a coin to one of your portfolios (B3)
post.description: Callable. The only way to create a coin doc. Enforces the plan coin cap and onboarding gate server-side, a 2s cooldown and 100 adds/UTC day. Acts on context.auth.uid only. Returns { success, coinCount }.

200.description: The coin was created; coinCount is the portfolio's new coin count.

400.description: invalid-argument (bad or unknown field, journal field over 2000 chars) / failed-precondition (plan not chosen, portfolio not found, or coin cap reached). details.reason: invalid-or-denied, missing-target or limit.

401.description: Not signed in.

409.description: already-exists — the coin is already in this portfolio; nothing is written and the counter is unchanged. Carries details.reason:'already-exists'.

429.description: resource-exhausted — the 2s add cooldown or the 100/UTC-day add budget was tripped. Carries details.reason:'rate-limited'.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Add a transaction to one of your coins (B3)
post.description: Callable. The only way to create a transaction doc. Enforces the plan transaction cap and onboarding gate server-side, a 500ms cooldown and 500 adds/UTC day. Acts on context.auth.uid only. Returns { success, txId, txCount }.

200.description: The transaction was created; txCount is the coin's new transaction count and txId is the new auto-id doc id.

400.description: invalid-argument (bad or unknown field) / failed-precondition (plan not chosen, coin not found, or transaction cap reached). details.reason: invalid-or-denied, missing-target or limit.

401.description: Not signed in.

429.description: resource-exhausted — the 500ms add cooldown or the 500/UTC-day add budget was tripped. Carries details.reason:'rate-limited'.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Cancel the signed-in user's subscription (access runs to period end)
post.description: Callable. Cancels the caller's own PayPal subscription; the tier is NOT dropped immediately — access continues until the paid period ends. A premium user may target `pro`.

401.description: Not signed in.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Un-cancel a pending downgrade ("Keep my plan")
post.description: Callable. Clears the caller's cancellation marker so the paid tier continues. After a scheduled Pro downgrade it cancels the scheduled Pro sub and access ends at period end instead.

401.description: Not signed in.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Clear a pending Premium→Pro re-checkout marker
post.description: Callable. Clears the caller's own `subscription` re-checkout marker so the prompt doesn't recur across devices.

401.description: Not signed in.

post.description: Callable, owner only, with a password re-auth in the last ~600s. Grants or revokes the manager role by email; revoking also signs the target out. Owners and the caller cannot be targeted.

400.description: invalid-argument — a valid email is required.

404.description: not-found — no user with that email.

500.description: failed-precondition — owner target, or the caller's own account.

post.summary: Read saved app config to pre-fill Settings (owner + Settings-password unlock)
post.description: Callable, owner only, behind the Settings-password unlock (or a recent re-auth if no Settings password is set). Secrets are returned only as set-flags.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

403.description: permission-denied — owners only. (A missing Settings-password unlock is reported as `failed-precondition` `settings-locked`, or `reauth-required` in the pre-password bootstrap.)

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Save app config / API keys (owner + Settings-password unlock)
post.description: Callable, owner only, behind the Settings-password unlock. Writes the server-only app config. A blank secret field keeps the saved value; secrets are never echoed.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

403.description: permission-denied — owners only. (A missing Settings-password unlock is reported as `failed-precondition` `settings-locked`, or `reauth-required` in the pre-password bootstrap.)

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Set or change the owner-only Settings password
post.description: Callable, owner only. Sets or changes the Settings password (hashed server-side). First set needs a recent re-auth; a change needs the current password or a live unlock. Grants a ~10-min unlock.

400.description: invalid-argument — the new password fails the strength floor (min 12 incl. upper+lower+number), or an unexpected field was sent.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

403.description: permission-denied — owners only; or (on a change) the current password is wrong and there is no live unlock; or (on a first set) the step-up re-auth is missing/stale (`reauth-required`).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Unlock the Settings screen with the Settings password
post.description: Callable, owner only. Checks the Settings password and grants a ~10-min unlock. Rate-limited per user per day; failed attempts are audited.

200.description: Unlocked — returns the unlock expiry (`until`, ms epoch).

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

403.description: permission-denied — owners only, or the Settings password is incorrect.

429.description: resource-exhausted — too many unlock attempts today (per-uid daily cap).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Email a Settings-password reset link
post.description: Callable, owner only. Emails a single-use reset link to the caller's own verified address. failed-precondition if no Settings password is set. Rate-limited per day.

200.description: Reset link sent (or logged in dev).

400.description: invalid-argument — an unexpected field was sent; OR `failed-precondition` (no Settings password is set to reset). Both map to HTTP 400.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

429.description: resource-exhausted — too many reset requests today (per-uid daily cap).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.summary: Complete a Settings-password reset with the emailed token
post.description: Callable, owner only. Redeems the single-use reset token and sets the new password (min 12, upper+lower+number). Grants a ~10-min unlock.

200.description: Reset — the new Settings password is active and the caller holds a fresh unlock.

400.description: invalid-argument — the new password fails the strength floor, or an unexpected field was sent.

401.description: Unauthenticated — missing, invalid, or expired ID token.

403.description: permission-denied — owners only, or the reset link is invalid / used / expired / belongs to a different account.

429.description: resource-exhausted — too many attempts today (per-uid daily cap).

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

post.description: PayPal subscription events. Each is signature-verified before any write; idempotent per event id. Not called by clients.

401.description: Invalid webhook signature.

default.description: Unexpected error — see the error body.

FirebaseAuth.description: Firebase ID token as `Authorization: Bearer <idToken>`. Admin operations also need the {admin:true} claim and a role; some owner operations need a recent re-auth or the Settings unlock.

PayPalWebhookSignature.name: paypal-transmission-sig
PayPalWebhookSignature.description: PayPal webhook signature (paypal-* headers), verified with PayPal before the event is trusted.

CallableError.description: Firebase callable error envelope (returned with a non-2xx HTTP status).

status.description: Canonical status, e.g. UNAUTHENTICATED, PERMISSION_DENIED, INVALID_ARGUMENT, RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED, FAILED_PRECONDITION, NOT_FOUND, INTERNAL.

details.description: Optional. addCoinGuarded and addTransactionGuarded set details.reason: limit, missing-target, invalid-or-denied, rate-limited or already-exists (coins only).

PricesResponse.description: Map of coin id → price entry.

paidPlansEnabled.description: Whether new paid subscriptions are available (LAUNCH-FREE). Default false; true only when set to exactly true. Enforced server-side too.

announcement.description: The active site announcement ({text, level}), or null.

Announcement.description: Site announcement banner. `active` is forced false when text is empty.

UserSnapshot.description: Read-only snapshot returned by viewUserAsAdmin. Capped at 20 portfolios, 150 coins and 50 transactions per coin; `truncated` flags say when more exists.

hp.description: Honeypot field — must be empty. Any value is silently dropped.

SetSettingsPasswordEnvelope.description: Set or change the owner-only Settings password.

next.description: The new Settings password (sent over TLS; scrypt-hashed server-side, never stored or echoed). Server floor: min 12 incl. upper+lower+number.

current.description: The current Settings password — required to CHANGE an existing one unless a live unlock is held; ignored on a first-time set.

UnlockSettingsEnvelope.description: Unlock the Settings screen with the Settings password.

password.description: The Settings password to unlock with.

CompleteSettingsPwResetEnvelope.description: Redeem an emailed reset token and set the new Settings password.

token.description: The single-use reset token from the emailed link (hex; looked up server-side by its sha256 hash).

next.description: The new Settings password (sent over TLS; scrypt-hashed server-side, never stored or echoed). Server floor: min 12 incl. upper+lower+number.

billing.description: Billing cycle for the scheduled Pro sub. Defaults to monthly.
Billing cycle for the scheduled Premium sub. Defaults to monthly.

question.description: The user's question about their OWN portfolio. Non-blank, trimmed; capped at 500 characters.

answer.description: The validated answer text. Empty string on a fail-closed fallback (fellBack:true).

fellBack.description: True when the fail-closed orchestrator hit the regen cap without a clean+judge-safe candidate — the answer is then the empty safe fallback, never violating text.

portfolioId.description: The caller's own portfolio to add the coin to. Non-blank; the coin lands under context.auth.uid — never a body uid.

coin.description: The coin to add. Keyed by coin.id (the coin-doc id); symbol/name are re-clamped server-side (symbol ≤20, name ≤64, thumb ≤512).

id.description: The CoinGecko coin id — becomes the coin-doc id.

symbol.description: Ticker symbol; clamped to 20 chars server-side.

name.description: Display name; clamped to 64 chars server-side.

thumb.description: Optional icon URL; clamped to 512 chars server-side.

journal.description: Optional thesis journal stored on the coin. Text fields ≤2000 chars; status is coerced to the enum.

funnel.description: Optional manual-research findings; each field ≤2000 chars.

success.description: True when the coin was created.

coinCount.description: The portfolio's coin count after the add.

portfolioId.description: The caller's own portfolio holding the coin. Non-blank; the tx lands under context.auth.uid — never a body uid.

coinId.description: The coin-doc id to add the transaction to (must already exist). Non-blank.

tx.description: The transaction to add. Only these fields are persisted; a stray extra is dropped server-side.

priceAtBuy.description: Unit price at the transaction; finite, ≥ 0, ≤ 1e9.

success.description: True when the transaction was created.

txId.description: The new transaction's auto-generated doc id.

txCount.description: The coin's transaction count after the add.

downgradeTo.description: Only a premium user may target pro.

AdminEntry.description: One admin account — operational identity only, never a secret.

details.description: Summary of the action. For saveConfig, a field diff with secrets shown only as '(changed)'; non-owners see a placeholder instead of the diff.

ip.description: Source IP of the action, or empty when unknown (e.g. under the emulator).

result.description: Secrets appear ONLY as boolean set-flags — never the values.

email.description: SMTP-only email — provider-agnostic (any email provider works via SMTP; no provider name is stored). Sends the landing-form signup notification and the Settings-password reset link.

smtpHost.description: SMTP host for outbound email (any provider).

smtpSecure.description: Implicit TLS (true on port 465; STARTTLS on 587 is false).

smtpPassSet.description: Whether an SMTP password is stored. The value is never returned.

requireAdminMfa.description: Require a second sign-in factor on every admin callable. Default false. Admin-only, not on /api/config. Omitted on save = keep.

paidPlansEnabled.description: Whether new paid subscriptions are available (LAUNCH-FREE). Default false; true only when set to exactly true. Omitted on save = keep.

generationModel.description: The generation model id (admin config, not a secret) — paste to switch model/provider without a code change.

judgeModel.description: The judge model id (admin config, not a secret).

baseUrl.description: Optional AI provider API base URL (admin config, not a secret). Blank uses the deploy-time default.

monthlyCapCents.description: The app-wide monthly AI spend cap in whole cents (default 5000 = $50). Operational config, NOT a secret — returned as a full number the Settings form can show and edit.

settingsAuth.description: Whether a Settings password is set and when it last changed. The hash never leaves the server.

sentry.description: Whether a Sentry DSN is stored. The value is never returned.

data.description: A blank secret field (keys.coingecko, keys.paypalSecret, keys.providerKey, keys.sentryDsn, email.smtpPass) KEEPS the currently-saved value.

providerKey.description: The AI provider API key. keep()-guarded: blank KEEPS the stored value; never echoed back.

generationModel.description: The generation model id (not a secret). KEEP-on-omit: absent preserves the stored value.

judgeModel.description: The judge model id (not a secret). KEEP-on-omit: absent preserves the stored value.

aiBaseUrl.description: Optional AI provider API base URL (not a secret). KEEP-on-omit: absent preserves the stored value.

sentryDsn.description: Sentry DSN. Blank keeps the stored value.

aiMonthlyCapCents.description: App-wide monthly AI spend cap in cents (default 5000 = $50). Not a secret. Omitted = keep; clamped to a non-negative integer.

email.description: SMTP-only email — provider-agnostic (any provider works via SMTP; no provider name is stored).

smtpHost.description: SMTP host for outbound email (any provider).

smtpSecure.description: Implicit TLS (true on port 465; STARTTLS on 587 is false).

smtpPass.description: SMTP password. Blank keeps the stored value; never echoed back.

requireAdminMfa.description: Require a second sign-in factor on every admin callable. Default false. Admin-only, not on /api/config. Omitted on save = keep.

paidPlansEnabled.description: Whether new paid subscriptions are available (LAUNCH-FREE). Default false; true only when set to exactly true. Omitted on save = keep.

flags.description: A switch omitted from `features` KEEPS its stored value (per-key merge) — it is never re-enabled by omission.

PayPalEvent.description: A PayPal webhook event. Only trusted after signature verification.

DailyStat.description: One UTC day of aggregate growth metrics. No personal data.

date.description: UTC calendar day, YYYY-MM-DD. Also the document id, so ids sort chronologically.

paidUsers.description: pro + premium. Stored explicitly, not derived at read time: it is the churn denominator and a historical snapshot must keep meaning what it meant that day.

canceledSubs.description: Subscriptions cancelled but still holding a paid tier until endDate (forward-looking churn signal).

pastDueSubs.description: Subscriptions with a failed payment, inside the 7-day grace.

signups24h.description: Accounts created in the 24h before this capture (from Auth creationTime).

grossRevenue.description: Monthly-equivalent gross, cycle-true (annual payers at priceYear/12). Rounded to cents.

netRevenue.description: gross - fees. The MRR figure the Overview trends.

limit.description: How many of the most recent days to return. Clamped server-side to 1..400.

capped.description: True when the result filled the requested limit, so older snapshots may exist.

FeatureFlags.description: Per-feature kill-switches. marketData is on unless set to false; checkout and aiResearch are off unless set to true.

marketData.description: CoinGecko prices/search/coinlist/trending/history. Off = serve cache, make zero upstream calls.

checkout.description: New PayPal subscriptions. Off = createSubscription refuses with failed-precondition. Default false (PAYMENTS-OFF-BY-DEFAULT).

aiResearch.description: AI research. Off = Research shows the Overview only and researchAsk refuses. Default false (RESEARCH-AI-OFF-LAUNCH).

JobHealth.description: One scheduled job's heartbeat. `at` is null when the job has NEVER completed — which is a distinct state from healthy, not an absence.

everyMs.description: The job's expected interval; the client flags it late past 2x this.

at.description: Last run that COMPLETED (incl. a deliberate kill-switch skip). null = never.

note.description: e.g. "skipped — marketData off", so unchanged data has a stated reason.

errorAt.description: Last run that threw. Newer than `at` = currently failing.

result.description: Operational status for the admin Overview strip. Contains NO secrets — the Sentry DSN is reported only as a boolean.

paidPlansEnabled.description: Whether new paid subscriptions are available (LAUNCH-FREE). Default false; true only when set to exactly true.

sentryConfigured.description: True only when a WELL-FORMED DSN is stored — 'configured but malformed' must not read as on.

now.description: Server clock, so the client computes ages without trusting the browser's.
